| | ETH | USDC |
|---|---|---|
| Before | 1.0 (1000000000000000000 wei) | 0 |
| Swap | sell 0.99 (990000000000000000 wei) | receive 2,967.000000 (2967000000 base units) |
| After | about 0.01, minus gas | 2,967.000000 |

- **Price:** this works out to about $2,997 per ETH.
- **Slippage limit:** 0.5%. The swap should land within about 12 seconds.
- **Timing:** the quote expires 300 seconds after it was issued. If it expires before I run the swap, I'll get a new quote and check it against the same limits.

Reply **approve** to run it, **reject** to cancel, or give me a cost cap.
